mining.prerequisite_semantics: Every trigger has some same-case predecessor ending no later than its start; not necessarily immediately preceding.
mining.interval_semantics: Integer frame boundaries, nonempty half-open [start_frame, end_frame_exclusive).
mining.scope: Descriptive bounds and rules on the supplied ground-truth population; not held-out validation.

requested_variant_selection.tie_policy: Include every exact-sequence variant tied at the cutoff frequency.
requested_variant_selection.variant_semantics: Exact ordered GT activity sequence after NA removal; adjacent equal labels are not merged; empty cases are included.
requested_variant_selection.ordering: Descending variant frequency, then lexicographic activity sequence.
